patterns.note: Full-width sections often employ a split-screen or multi-column grid layout for content presentation, such as the hero and various product showcases.
Headings are consistently bold, sans-serif, and significantly larger than body text, establishing a clear visual hierarchy.
A deep, rich blue (#2121a1) is used as a primary accent color for CTAs, interactive elements, and section backgrounds, contrasting with a predominantly white and black palette.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing content engagement.
The 'Our stores' section features unique, detailed line-art illustrations of building facades, providing a distinctive visual anchor.

technique_notes: To achieve the section reveal effect, use CSS keyframes to animate elements from a slightly lower opacity and position (e.g., translateY(20px)) to full opacity and original position as they scroll into view.
The hero section uses a full-bleed, two-column layout with large, impactful imagery and overlaid text that is legible due to a subtle dark gradient or overlay on the images.
Product displays are organized into flexible grids that adapt to different screen sizes, maintaining consistent padding around each item for a clean, organized look.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and significantly larger than the clean, readable body text, creating a strong visual hierarchy with ample contrast in size and weight.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant for most structural elements, with subtle rounding applied to interactive elements like buttons and some image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and consistent internal padding within content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The distinctive line-art illustrations for the 'Our stores' section, combined with the strong, consistent use of a deep blue accent color, give the site a unique blend of modern e-commerce and a touch of artistic flair.
